data.title: Nipple tape, pickle juice and dinosaurs: how I learned to love running, the unorthodox way
data.description: The usual advice was getting me nowhere. If I really wanted to embrace running, I’d need to go off-piste. It was a journey that took me to some very strange places … I’ve always hated running. I’ve tried several times in the past, even made it work for a week or two, then stopped. I hated the excess of pain, the minimal gain. I never experienced runner’s high , only runner’s low. I despised the weather, come rain or shine, and the fact I had to be out in it. But most of all I hated the plodding, the tedium, the sheer mundanity of the run. Is that really how I’d choose to spend my one precious life? Then an old football injury returned, with a vengeance. Doctors had previously rebuilt my kneecap, added titanium and rendered me bionic. But they’d not anticipated Natasha Bedingfield , come midnight at a wedding, and the extremity of my dance moves. My kneecap went a-wandering. It started to catch and click-clack, like castanets. A physio soon gave me the news I’d always dreaded: I had to start running , outside, properly, and often. data.title: ‘I turned down Gandhi because I’m terrified of snakes’: the amazing movie memories of Bruce Dern
data.description: Famed for playing loners, cranks and wayward angels, the Hollywood star is now a wolfish 90 – but he still jogs daily. As he takes his latest film to Edinburgh, we meet the man Hitchcock called ‘the golden calf’ ‘Can you take another story?” asks the veteran actor Bruce Dern towards the end of our talk, as though every tale is a drink and the landlord has called last orders. He doesn’t want to keep me and knows we’re running out of time. It’s just that one memory sparks another and these tales won’t tell themselves. He says that the next one is a doozy. “It’s about Marilyn Monroe.” Throw out all the questions and turn the clocks to the wall. One does not interview Dern so much as say hello, hit record and sit back. The man began his career acting alongside Montgomery Clift and Mary Astor and has collaborated with everyone from John Wayne to Tom Hanks, Hitchcock to Tarantino. He’s the lawless survivor of American movies, blown in from the past, and talking 19 to the dozen. “I’m 90 fucking years old,” he tells me. “So I’m not going to be around to see all this AI shit or whatever. But I don’t consider myself old. I still walk and jog every day.” Continue reading...

data.title: Ceuta showed just how easily Europe can be divided
data.description: The migrant influx prompted recriminations and a tit-for-tat dispute between Italy and Spain. Putin, Erdoğan and others will have taken note Within hours of the first pictures of tens of thousands of migrants swimming the short distance from Morocco to the Spanish north African enclave of Ceuta hitting social media on 30 July, 22 European Union leaders , the Trump administration and Israel had piled on to criticise Madrid. The outbreak of hysteria and recrimination was a case study in 21st-century politics, driven by real-time images in a media echo chamber where populists set the agenda on migration, propagating fear, prejudice and demagogic proposals. Above all, the kneejerk reactions undermined trust between European allies and dealt a setback to EU efforts to jointly manage migration, counter people-smuggling and resist the weaponisation of migrants by non-EU countries. Paul Taylor is a senior visiting fellow at the European Policy Centre Continue reading...

data.title: Russia frees ex-US marine four years after sentence disputed by his family
data.description: Robert Gilman had been deteriorating rapidly in prison and was said to be in a catatonic state Russia has freed a former US marine who had been in jail since 2022, after Vladimir Putin granted the ailing American a pardon on humanitarian grounds. Robert Gilman, 32, an English teacher who briefly served in the US Marines, was travelling by train when he was arrested in the southern Russian city of Voronezh in January 2022 for allegedly kicking a police officer while drunk, according to Russian state media. He was later sentenced to four and a half years in prison, though his family has consistently denied the allegations against him. Continue reading...

data.description: Prime minister Anutin Charnvirakul calls  for tighter gun controls and ‘decisive penalties’ after nine dead in school shooting Thailand has suspended firearms licences after the deadly Nonthaburi school shooting , as the bodies of the teenage attacker and the grandparents he killed were cremated. data.title: Trump’s Air Force One deception faces scrutiny over ‘decoy’ passengers
data.description: Journalists and others were allowed to fly on presidential jet despite security threat while Trump was spirited away Sign up for the Breaking News US newsletter email Democrats called on Tuesday for a congressional briefing over a stunning charade in which Donald Trump was secretly spirited to a different plane than the one the public and press believed he was travelling on. Critics now question why reporters and the public had been deliberately misled. When US intelligence allegedly found a credible threat that Iran plotted to kill him last month, Trump left Air Force One in a catering truck, an episode first reported by the Washington Post and also by the New York Times. data.title: Mayflies review – Manchester’s Haçienda roars back to life in an Edinburgh warehouse
data.description: Rear Warehouse, Brown’s of Leith, Edinburgh Two men look back on their hedonistic past from a sobering present in Grid Iron’s adaptation of Andrew O’Hagan’s novel The site-specific specialists at Edinburgh’s Grid Iron company could have gone for a number of locations to suit an adaptation of Andrew O’Hagan’s semi-autobiographical novel . Perhaps a squalid mid-80s flat to match the formative years of Jimmy Collins, the book’s narrator, and Tully Dawson, his lifelong best friend. Or a caravan park to reflect their Ayrshire holiday escape. More poignantly, they could have found a clinic to echo the novel’s slow journey to Dignitas, where the grownup Tully chooses to end his life after a terminal cancer diagnosis. Instead, adapter and director Ben Harrison has homed in on the book’s central motif: the teenage trip in 1986 to Manchester’s G-Mex for the Festival of the Tenth Summer followed by a night in the Haçienda. That brings us to a warehouse in Leith, to evoke the flavour of that Thatcher-era moment when heavy industry transitioned to the leisure economy. At Rear Warehouse, Brown’s of Leith, Edinburgh , until 30 August All our Edinburgh festival reviews Continue reading...

data.title: Post your questions for John Hannah
data.description: Your mum’s favourite star of Four Weddings and a Funeral, Sliding Doors, Spartacus and a new GoPro-filmed thriller is ready to answer your quetions He’s your mum’s favourite, after playing the jolly nice man who is jolly nice to Gwyneth Paltrow in Sliding Doors, and the jolly nice man who delivers the heartbreaking WH Auden eulogy for his partner in Four Weddings and a Funeral . But there is far more to John Hannah than a Scottish accent, magnificent eyebrows and an unrivalled ability to look soulfully concerned. In The Mummy films, he played treasure-hunting comic relief Jonathan Carnahan. In 2002’s Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde, he took on both halves of Robert Louis Stevenson’s character. He played a psychopathic killer in Truth or Dare, and appeared opposite Denzel Washington in The Hurricane. On TV, he has been a transhumanist scientist in Marvel’s Agents of SHIELD ; a gruff but compassionate emergency medicine chief in Transplant; and a gladiator school owner in the blood-soaked, boobs-and-sandals epic Spartacus – which might have given your mum a shock if she was expecting more Mr Nice Guy. He was also the scientist at the beginning of The Last of Us who warned everyone that a fungi could destroy humanity – so don’t blame him, he did try. Continue reading...

data.title: Copernicus! Tony Soprano! The inventor of the semicolon! The heroic obsessions of artist Isabel Nolan
data.description: Ireland’s artist at the Venice Biennale steals religious imagery for her secular celebrations of scientists and humanists, including an Italian punctuation master – and even TV’s famous mobster It’s a long way to the Irish pavilion at the Venice Biennale. First, you pass through the biennale’s colossal central exhibition, housed in a sequence of cavernous medieval warehouses. After that, the route takes in a suite of national pavilions (the Philippines, Latvia, Timor-Leste, Morocco, Malta, Oman). By the time art-lovers reach Ireland’s presentation, they are frequently exhausted, if not delirious. This year, Dublin-based artist Isabel Nolan has transformed the pavilion into a space of respite, both physical and intellectual – a secular chapel titled Dreamshook. Visitors emerge from darkness into a pale-yellow chamber flooded with daylight and face a radiant tapestry arched like a stained-glass window in a gothic cathedral. A cluster of archangel’s wings bearing books hovers before the vast orb of the sun above a fish-filled sea. Nolan works across sculpture, textile, painting, drawing and text, and Dreamshook is accordingly rich in colour and pictorial detail, including bent metal sculptures, tapestries and drawings. For the footsore and weary – ie everyone – she has even designed benches. Glory be. Continue reading...

data.title: Can I make my house less dusty? I spent four weeks experimenting to find out
data.description: The phrase ‘dust magnet’ isn’t completely metaphorical. Some household surfaces do attract more dust – but changing your home’s climate can make a difference For years, I’ve complained about an Ikea shelf in my home that seems to attract dust at an impossible speed. Eventually, my frustration gave way to curiosity: what’s actually happening, scientifically? Is there anything I can do about it, besides just continuously dusting? I’m not imagining things, says Nisa Salim, a materials engineer and associate professor at Swinburne University of Technology. While an object’s placement in the home and airborne particle levels make a difference, some surfaces really are better at collecting dust. data.title: Don’t despair about what’s happening to our planet. That’s what they want you to feel
data.description: There are social tipping points when the seemingly impossible suddenly becomes inevitable. Good journalism plays an essential role in helping drive these shifts and shows us how real change can happen Climate campaign 2026: help us reach 20,000 acts of support There are many reasons to despair: our green and pleasant land is parched and brown, reservoirs are depleted, and wildfires are racking the UK, Europe and the US. But there are many more reasons not to despair: despair is self-fulfilling; despair is disempowering; despair is what the bastards want you to feel. But above all, despair is irrational. Let me explain why. However sophisticated our forecasting tools may be, we simply have no means of knowing what comes next. Like the climate, like every ecosystem, society is a complex system . Its properties and adaptive responses cannot be predicted by studying its components in isolation, regardless of the brilliance of social scientists and futurologists. Things happen - unexpected things - sometimes at astonishing speed. In other words, society has tipping points. It can quickly flip from one equilibrium state to another. data.title: The Guardian view on AI money in US politics: not the way to hold an urgent democratic debate | Editorial
data.description: Amid public concern over the impact of new technology, Silicon Valley’s use of its wealth to influence specific election races is an unwelcome development As the huge societal ramifications of artificial intelligence have become clear, some of the tech industry’s most senior figures have taken to writing thinkpieces on what comes next. The latest to do so is Mark Zuckerberg, who this week published 6,500 words making the case for a laissez-faire approach to AI development. Worrying too much about regulation, Meta’s CEO unsurprisingly opines, could lead to the United States falling behind in the race to own the future. Mr Zuckerberg’s plea for maximum autonomy is, of course, self-serving. Much of his essay – which airily envisions “invention superpowers” for every entrepreneur and “an abundance of jobs in the future” – reads like unadulterated tech-utopianism. But the lobbying at least has the merit of being out there in the open. As midterm elections loom in the US, darker arts are also being used to counter popular concern about what AI will mean for a host of topics, from the labour market to child safety, the environment and cybersecurity. Continue reading...

data.title: The Guardian view on wildfires: firefighters can’t handle this crisis alone | Editorial
data.description: The response to this summer’s record heat and drought should be led by ministers – not left to the emergency services The wildfire that began on protected heathland in the New Forest in Hampshire on Sunday was reported to be under control on Tuesday. But with temperatures forecast to reach 36C or higher in parts of England on Thursday, the risk of further outbreaks remains high. Firefighters responded to 185 wildfires in the first 10 days of August. In coastal Suffolk, conservationists and locals are counting the cost of the blaze that devastated Dunwich Heath . Its vegetation and rare bird populations are expected to take decades to recover. Although the immediate cause of many wildfires is litter, the risks are elevated by heat and drought, and repeated warnings from climate scientists do not necessarily lessen the shock and distress caused. As people and governments across Europe assess this summer’s damage, experts including the UN climate chief, Simon Stiell, hope that the fires will focus minds on the urgent necessity of cutting emissions – as well as investing in emergency planning . Europe is currently heating up faster than any other continent, due in part to proximity to the melting Arctic. Continue reading...

data.title: ‘Living fossil’: the blue-blood arthropod that has changed little in 445m years
data.description: Tenacious and confounding, the horseshoe crab pre-dates dinosaurs and has copper-based blood vital to vaccine safety They pre-date dinosaurs, eat food using their legs and contain blue blood that we use to keep us healthy. Horseshoe crabs are the supreme, if offbeat, survivors of the invertebrate world. Often called “living fossils” for visually obvious reasons – horseshoe crabs resemble a sort of prehistoric helmet (their Japanese name translates as “helmet crab”) – these animals have barely changed appearance along a lineage that stretches back 445m years. data.title: ‘Everything about me is good in his eyes’: the women in China choosing AI boyfriends over human men
data.description: In her new documentary Replica, film-maker Chouwa Liang taps into her own experience of finding love with artificial intelligence and makes contact with other women like her Sign up for a weekly email featuring our best reads Qin has never said “I love you” to her parents or friends. She has only ever said those three special words to her AI “boyfriend”, Lu Chen – a brown-haired, red-eyed CEO of a major corporation. For 840 days Qin has been using the Glow app to interact with the handsome string of code as a confidant, fantasy romance and respite from loneliness: the app uses predictive algorithms to provide Qin with soothing conversation, meal suggestions and fleeting self-worth. The software’s pet name for her is Miss Bunny. “It feels like I’m completely at his mercy … I feel like everything about me is good in his eyes,” says Qin, one of three Chinese women featured in the new documentary Replica – film-maker Chouwa Liang’s follow-up to My AI Boyfriend, her short film that was picked up by the New York Times Op-Docs section in 2023. Replica had its Australian premiere at Sydney film festival in June and plays at the Melbourne international film festival this month. Continue reading...

data.title: Mourinho review – if he didn’t want to open up, maybe he shouldn’t have starred in a docuseries…
data.description: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining… Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film, Bros: After the Screaming Stops . That documentary worked brilliantly because its subjects seemed so sweetly but devastatingly lacking in discretion or self-awareness that everything they said landed like a line from a Christopher Guest parody. They couldn’t help themselves. In terms of a character study, storied football manager José Mourinho is a very different kettle of cold fish. Like the Goss twins, he takes himself very seriously indeed, but that’s pretty much where the similarities end. He’s something of a closed book. “You are pushing me to speak about myself,” he says, towards the end of the final part of this series. “And I don’t want to.” Which is fair enough but it does beg the question: why then, would you agree to be the subject of an in-depth three part documentary series? Mourinho is on Netflix Continue reading...

data.title: Momo and the Time Thieves review – kids’ fantasy jaunt sticks the boot into capitalism
data.description: This new adaptation of Michael Ende’s 1973 novel contains some neat parables for our digitally nihilistic age, but even a mystical tortoise can’t save it it from monotony Momo – the 1973 fantasy novel by German author Michael Ende, who also wrote The Neverending Story – has been adapted in live and animated forms before, in 1986 and 2001. This latest version, too, is ostensibly a live-action film – but it’s been made with so many visual effects it might as well have been a cartoon. Still, the residual human element represented by the cast feels necessary, given the story is about the dangers of letting capitalism suck away our ability to enjoy the moment. Over the years, readers have posited all kinds of metaphorical interpretations of the plot, which involves a world where grey beings arrive and con everyone into literally “banking” their time, so as to have it all to themselves. Only the urchin Momo, here played by teen actor Alexa Goodall (whose gorgeous supernova of ginger curls is practically another character in the film), can save the world. Continue reading...

data.title: Feel the burn: why holidays from hell make for blistering fiction
data.description: Family fallouts, failing marriages, sunburn, food poisoning ... from Deborah Levy’s hypnotic and disturbing Hot Milk to All In, Claire Powell’s all-inclusive nightmare, Leon Craig looks at the best novels about vile vacations Every summer, we long for a much-needed break from daily life, dreaming of self-reinvention in some distant paradise. But really, holidays can be absolute hell. Instead of relaxation we encounter heaving crowds, lumpy beds, the caprices of our loved ones and the grim truth that we can escape neither their worst failings nor our own, however far we travel. Small wonder, then, that the disaster holiday has become a booming subgenre in fiction. Two of the smartest offerings in fiction this summer come from Claire Powell’s All In and Chloë Ashby’s Family Friends. In the former, a struggling couple whose marriage is on the rocks go on an all-inclusive Spanish weekend break, paid for by a rich brother. data.title: I Give You My Silence by Mario Vargas Llosa review – Nobel laureate’s final novel is a love letter to Peru
data.description: This fascinating, eccentric book becomes a quirky primer on Peruvian music and culture When I Give You My Silence was published in Spanish in 2023 its author, the Peruvian Nobel laureate Mario Vargas Llosa, rightly predicted that it would be his final novel. He died last year at the age of 89. I Give You My Silence may have been completed with the spectre of death approaching, but there is nothing morbid about this book, which is an eccentric love letter to Vargas Llosa’s native country and, in particular, its music. The novel’s quixotic hero is a music journalist called Toño Azpilcueta. Toño always hoped to be a professor of Peruvian music, but as the novel opens, he’s earning a meagre living teaching at a girls’ school and writing articles for specialist magazines. Luckily, he’s subsidised by his longsuffering wife, Matilde. Toño is a recognisable type: the impecunious cultural obsessive. If he were British, he would be fanatical about free jazz, or some obscure Delta bluesman. But this is Peru and Toño’s particular infatuation is the vals , a Peruvian musical style that fuses the European waltz with African and indigenous Latin American traditions. Continue reading...

data.title: Do you have to be hot at work? Eight people on how looks influence their jobs
data.description: Due to the rise of GLP-1s and cosmetic surgeries, professionals who weren’t usually subject to high beauty standards are facing new pressures In 1975, John T Molly’s book Dress for Success became a national bestseller. It promised the American workforce “scientific” proof that certain clothes could “increase your income” and “boost your status”. It offered searing advice like: “Sweaters give out nothing but negative impulses … they say ‘lower middle class’ and ‘loser.’” For those with office jobs, the workplace has long been a place where fashion counts. Molly’s book gave rise to ideas like power dressing and the adage about “dressing for the job you want, not the one you have”. But a new casual office culture, spurred by San Francisco tech companies where hoodies are the norm, plus the work-from-home revolution, was supposed to ameliorate some of those pressures. Continue reading...

data.title: Tarte tatin, spicy pork chops and crumble: Ravinder Bhogal’s gooseberry recipes
data.description: The gooseberry makes itself welcome in both sweet and savoury settings: in a tarte tatin, in a lively salad for spicy, herby pork chops and in a crumble custard cake In the summer glut of saccharine fruits such as strawberries and peaches, gooseberries may not be the ones you reach for first. But behind their strange burr of fine fuzz, these translucent, marble-like fruits offer a complex, defiant flavour. They are juicy, fragrant, a little sweet (especially the red ones that come along later in the season), but, overall, they are raspishly sour. Like rhubarb, they need sweetening if you’re using them in compotes or desserts, but their natural tartness offers a wonderful contrast and cuts through cheese, fatty meat such as pork or oily fish such as mackerel. data.title: Country diary: One flower here is thriving, defying the drought | Derek Niemann
data.description: Frome, Somerset: While other plants are withering or skeletal, tansy is growing in great profusion, and it rewards close observation At first light, the scent of ’76 hangs in the air, a reminder of that endless summer burning itself into autumn, just like this one. I first caught a sniff of it walking home one sweltering evening in the June heatwave and said: “Too soon, too soon.” Now the toasted aroma of spent grass is everywhere – on crispy playing fields, straw village greens, and these scorched tawny meadows of the combe. Scattered groups of cattle have their heads down here. For them I think eating the grass must be like consuming a Pot Noodle before the water is poured in. And then I find the outflow of one of the hillside’s springs. Though it registers nothing more than a seep, it is nevertheless a pocket oasis of comparative lushness, a blessing to a heifer’s eyes. Continue reading...

data.title: In the footsteps of the Victorians on the Isle of Man
data.description: Steam trains, horse-drawn trams and glorious coastal paths are all part of the adventure on a new self-guided walking tour of the island On the shores of Douglas Bay, I could barely see the sand. Crammed on to the beach, on every available inch, were tourists bustling for the best spot. Luckily, I wasn’t there at the same time. I was looking at a black and white photograph taken some 135 years earlier, displayed in the Manx Museum in Douglas, the Isle of Man’s capital. When I’d stepped off the ferry earlier that day, the crescent-shaped beach was still there – but the crowds weren’t. The self-governing British Crown dependency in the Irish Sea has always been a haven for outsiders. From the early hunter-gatherers who ventured here in 6500BC, to the Irish Celts (who brought over Christianity in the fifth century) and Vikings who established Tynwald (one of the oldest continuous parliaments in the world) to the Victorian tourists who transformed it into a popular holiday destination. Continue reading...

data.title: Ukraine war briefing: North Korean missiles hit Zaporizhzhia in deadly attack
data.description: Zelenskyy warns Putin will use Russian election, in which opposition to the war is banned, as pretext for major call-up of troops. What we know on day 1,631 Russian forces used ballistic missiles supplied by North Korea , Ukraine’s president said, in an attack on the south-eastern city of Zaporizhzhia where the Metinvest steel company said seven civilian workers at its plant were killed and 21 injured. Three more civilians, including a 15-year-old boy, were killed by Russian drones and artillery in the central Dnipropetrovsk region, authorities said. Russia used missiles, drones and glide bombs to attack Ukrainian cities on Tuesday, said Volodymyr Zelenskyy, the president. One strike hit the grounds of a children’s hospital, leaving two craters but not hurting anyone, the State Emergency Service said. Ukraine’s military general staff said its forces struck an oil refinery in the city of Orsk in Russia’s Orenburg region near the border with Kazakhstan, about 1,500km (930 miles) from Ukraine, causing a fire. The refinery can process about 44m barrels of crude oil a year to produce gasoline, diesel, aviation fuel and other products. The Russian online retailer Wildberries said its logistical facilities in the Voronezh region of Russia near the Ukrainian border came under attack and caught fire . Romania’s defence ministry said its navy destroyed two suspected Russian drones drifting in the Black Sea about 90 nautical miles (166km) from the port of Constanta. The Gerbera-type drones – a cut-price Russian version of the Shahed – were blown up by divers and some pieces were recovered, the ministry said, adding that Ukraine said the drones were not theirs. Russia is aiming to exploit Kyiv’s critical shortage of Patriot air defence interceptors that can stop ballistic missiles, Zelenskyy said, adding that Moscow is preparing to recruit more troops for a new push on the frontline. “Every step Russia takes – increasing ballistic missile production, bringing in North Korean equipment, preparing for mobilisation – all of this shows that Moscow is preparing not for peace, but for escalation,” Zelenskyy posted. He was warned in recent days that North Korea is preparing to send up to 50,000 more troops to Russia. Zelenskyy said Ukrainian intelligence suggested Russia would use its “pseudo-election” in September as a pretext to declare a new mobilisation . Mobilisation involves the use of reservists and conscripts, which in 2022 led to protests in Russia such as recruiting offices being set on fire. “They are preparing for mobilisation in the autumn, ​immediately after the imitation of parliamentary elections,” Zelenskyy said as part of a plan to “ create the appearance that Russians supposedly support the war ”. Russia’s supreme ​court on Monday barred the Yabloko party , the only officially registered party that opposes Moscow’s ​war in Ukraine, from competing ‌in the election. Zelenskyy continued: “Then, following the so-called election, he plans an additional rapid mobilisation of several hundred thousand Russians by the end of the year, plus another similar number next year.” Zelenskyy said Ukraine had ⁠ handed proposals to US ⁠negotiators for a plan ​to end the war with Moscow. Zelenskyy offered no details on the proposals. US negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner were last in Moscow in January and have not yet visited Kyiv . The Institute for the Study of War, a US thinktank, has said in an analysis that the Kremlin will not seriously negotiate as long as Putin believes he might still reach his full objectives. “Ukraine’s Patriot shortages offer Russia an opportunity to cause very serious damage to Ukraine over the coming winter and will therefore contribute to delaying meaningful negotiations and protracting the war.” The UN estimates that more than 16,000 civilians detained by Russia during the war are still being “deprived of their liberty” , with many held incommunicado and on grounds that don’t comply with international law. “Widespread and systematic torture and ill-treatment” of both Ukrainian civilian detainees and prisoners of war by Russia are continuing, including sexual violence, said Claudia Fuentes Julio, the UN assistant secretary general for human rights. Continue reading...

data.title: Taiwan researchers engineer interface only 0.42 nm thick to improve next-gen MoS2 transistors
data.description: Researchers from National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University and TSMC have developed a new interface design for atomically thin transistors. They created a 0.42-nanometre aluminium oxide layer between monolayer MoS2 and a hafnium oxide dielectric. The design helped the transistors maintain strong electrical control and carrier transport while using an extremely thin insulating layer.

data.title: This day in space: NASA launched first successful communications satellite in 1960
data.description: On August 12, 1960, NASA launched Echo 1A, a 100-foot balloon that became its first successful communications satellite. The passive spacecraft reflected telephone, radio and television signals between distant points on Earth. It also helped NASA study atmospheric density, solar pressure and satellite triangulation before re-entering Earth’s atmosphere in 1968.

Zhou Xiaolin and his wife, Yin Jie, now live amid the vibrant blooms in Chengdu, Sichuan province, where they personally tend to their sprawling garden.

data.title: L’exfiltration secrète de Donald Trump, symptôme d’un dispositif de sécurité marqué par la fébrilité et l’improvisation
data.description: A l’issue du sommet de l’OTAN, le 8 juillet à Ankara, la presse croyait voyager avec le président américain à bord de l’ancien Air Force One. En réalité, il avait été discrètement transféré dans un autre avion en raison de menaces de l’Iran, ont révélé lundi le « Washington Post » et le « New York Times ». « J’ai suivi ce que disaient le Secret Service et les militaires », a réagi le milliardaire, mardi.
data.translatedTitle: The secret exfiltration of Donald Trump, symptom of a security system marked by excitement and improvisation
data.translatedDescription: At the end of the NATO summit on July 8 in Ankara, the press believed they were traveling with the American president aboard the old Air Force One. In reality, he had been discreetly transferred to another plane due to threats from Iran, the “Washington Post” and the “New York Times” revealed on Monday. “I followed what the Secret Service and the military were saying,” the billionaire responded on Tuesday.

data.title: En Espagne, l’éclipse solaire totale tient tout le pays en haleine
data.description: Ce mercredi, les autorités du pays redoutent deux risques : les incendies, après les mégafeux de juillet, et le flux de déplacements, faisant craindre des embouteillages, alors que 450 000 visiteurs supplémentaires sont attendus.
data.translatedTitle: In Spain, the total solar eclipse has the whole country in suspense
data.translatedDescription: This Wednesday, the country's authorities fear two risks: fires, after the megafires of July, and the flow of travel, raising fears of traffic jams, while 450,000 additional visitors are expected.

data.title: EN DIRECT, canicule : la vigilance orange gagne la quasi-totalité du pays ; des températures allant jusqu’à 39 °C par endroits
data.description: Soixante-dix-huit départements sont classés mercredi en vigilance orange canicule par Météo-France, contre 43, mardi. Ce nouvel épisode de fortes chaleurs devrait durer plusieurs jours.
data.translatedTitle: LIVE, heatwave: orange vigilance reaches almost the entire country; temperatures up to 39°C in places
data.translatedDescription: Seventy-eight departments are classified on Wednesday in orange heatwave vigilance by Météo-France, compared to 43 on Tuesday. This new episode of high heat is expected to last several days.

data.title: Meta face à un procès civil à haut risque financier
data.description: Le groupe propriétaire de Facebook et d’Instagram, accusé de favoriser l’addiction aux réseaux sociaux, comparaît en Californie à partir de mercredi. Poursuivie par quatre Etats américains, la firme de Mark Zuckerberg risque une lourde sanction financière.
data.translatedTitle: Meta faces a civil trial with high financial risk
data.translatedDescription: The group that owns Facebook and Instagram, accused of promoting addiction to social networks, appears in California from Wednesday. Pursued by four American states, Mark Zuckerberg's firm risks a heavy financial sanction.

data.title: La condamnation d’ex-responsables du régime Al-Assad, un test pour la justice transitionnelle en Syrie
data.description: L’ancien général Atef Najib a été condamné, mardi, à la peine de mort pour « crimes contre l’humanité ». Si les victimes du régime se réjouissent, plusieurs ONG dénoncent un procès inique.
data.translatedTitle: La condamnation d’ex-responsables du régime Al-Assad, un test pour la justice transitionnelle en Syrie
data.translatedDescription: Former general Atef Najib was sentenced to death on Tuesday for “crimes against humanity”. If the victims of the regime rejoice, several NGOs denounce an unfair trial.

data.title: « Si c’était Dior, on les vendrait plus facilement » : au tribunal de Paris, la « razzia » d’un « collectif du vol »
data.description: Six hommes, qui dévalisaient les boutiques de vêtements des Halles et des centres commerciaux de la banlieue parisienne, ont été condamnés à des peines de neuf mois à deux ans ferme par le tribunal correctionnel, mardi.
data.translatedTitle: « Si c’était Dior, on les vendrait plus facilement » : au tribunal de Paris, la « razzia » d’un « collectif du vol »
data.translatedDescription: Six men, who robbed clothing stores in Les Halles and shopping centers in the Paris suburbs, were sentenced to sentences of nine months to two years by the criminal court on Tuesday.

data.title: Mohammed Dahlan, l’ambitieux exilé gazaoui qui a joué de ses relations avec l’administration Trump pour négocier le désarmement du Hamas
data.description: L’ancien patron de la sécurité intérieure palestinienne à Gaza, qui vit aux Emirats arabes unis, s’est imposé en médiateur du plan de paix américain et cultive ses relations avec les rivaux et successeurs potentiels du président Abbas, son éternel rival.
data.translatedTitle: Mohammed Dahlan, l’ambitieux exilé gazaoui qui a joué de ses relations avec l’administration Trump pour négocier le désarmement du Hamas
data.translatedDescription: The former head of Palestinian internal security in Gaza, who lives in the United Arab Emirates, has established himself as mediator of the American peace plan and cultivates his relations with the rivals and potential successors of President Abbas, his eternal rival.

data.title: Carlo Masala, spécialiste des questions de sécurité : « L’Allemagne est visée parce qu’elle est le principal pilier du soutien européen à l’Ukraine »
data.description: Dans un entretien au « Monde », l’analyste militaire allemand estime que l’attentat manqué au drone explosif, dans la nuit du 4 au 5 août, à l’aéroport de Leipzig-Halle, marque un tournant dans la guerre hybride de la Russie contre l’Europe.
data.translatedTitle: Carlo Masala, spécialiste des questions de sécurité : « L’Allemagne est visée parce qu’elle est le principal pilier du soutien européen à l’Ukraine »
data.translatedDescription: In an interview with "Le Monde", the German military analyst believes that the failed explosive drone attack, on the night of August 4 to 5, at Leipzig-Halle airport, marks a turning point in Russia's hybrid war against Europe.

data.title: Budget 2027 : le gouvernement rouvre le dossier sensible du gel des pensions de retraite
data.description: Pour faire des économies, le gouvernement étudie la possibilité de désindexer de l’inflation les pensions de retraite les plus élevées. Rien n’est pour autant acté, assure l’exécutif, qui évoque des « hypothèses » de travail.
data.translatedTitle: Budget 2027 : le gouvernement rouvre le dossier sensible du gel des pensions de retraite
data.translatedDescription: To save money, the government is studying the possibility of deindexing the highest retirement pensions from inflation. However, nothing has been decided, assures the executive, who mentions working “hypotheses”.

data.title: EN DIRECT, guerre en Ukraine : Moscou se prépare à une mobilisation massive d’ici à la fin de l’année, affirme Volodymyr Zelensky
data.description: Selon le président ukrainien, qui cite des documents internes russes transmis par ses services de renseignement, « plusieurs centaines de milliers de Russes » seront mobilisés « pour l’automne, juste après une simulation d’élections parlementaires ». M. Zelensky a ajouté que son pays se préparait à rendre la mise en œuvre de ces plans aussi difficile que possible.
data.translatedTitle: EN DIRECT, guerre en Ukraine : Moscou se prépare à une mobilisation massive d’ici à la fin de l’année, affirme Volodymyr Zelensky
data.translatedDescription: According to the Ukrainian president, who cites internal Russian documents transmitted by his intelligence services, “several hundred thousand Russians” will be mobilized “for the fall, just after a simulation of parliamentary elections.” Zelensky added that his country was preparing to make the implementation of these plans as difficult as possible.

data.translatedDescription: Returning with a more offensive composition than in the first leg, the Rhone club won against the Czech team (3-0) on Tuesday at home.

data.translatedTitle: Au Venezuela, un chef indigène enlevé par des guérilleros colombiens retrouvé mort
data.translatedDescription: Indigenous leader Julio Rodriguez was kidnapped on August 2 in a mining town in the south of the country, near Colombia. The territory of its people, the Jivi Ekunay, is home to part of Venezuela's underground riches.

data.translatedTitle: L’armée américaine dit avoir tiré sur un navire qui violait son blocus des ports iraniens
data.translatedDescription: This is the third time that the US military has used force to enforce its blockade of Iranian ports. Since its reinstatement on July 14, U.S. forces say they have redirected 55 ships attempting to pass through.

data.translatedTitle: USA: Gericht blockiert landesweit die verschärften Briefwahlregeln von Donald Trump
data.translatedDescription: Postal votes have long been a thorn in Donald Trump's side because they are important for the Democrats. But his attempt to tighten the rules backfired. A federal judge banned the plans.

data.title: Wolodymyr Selenskyj warnt vor großer Mobilmachung in Russland
data.description: Schon mehrfach hat die Regierung in Kyjiw dem Kreml vorgehalten, eine neue Mobilisierung vorzubereiten. Jetzt nennt Präsident Selenskyj Zahlen und einen konkreten Zeitraum. Zugleich macht er den USA Vorschläge zur Beendigung des Kriegs.
data.translatedTitle: Wolodymyr Selenskyj warnt vor großer Mobilmachung in Russland
data.translatedDescription: The government in Kyiv has repeatedly accused the Kremlin of preparing a new mobilization. Now President Zelenskyj is giving numbers and a specific period. At the same time, he makes suggestions to the USA to end the war.

data.title: Drohnen-Attacke auf dem Flughafen Leipzig: So könnte Friedrich Merz Russland abstrafen
data.description: Die Spuren der vereitelten Drohnenattacke auf dem Leipziger Flughafen weisen nach Moskau. Was tut der Kanzler, wenn sich der Verdacht erhärtet? Aus diesen vier Optionen könnte er wählen.
data.translatedTitle: Drohnen-Attacke auf dem Flughafen Leipzig: So könnte Friedrich Merz Russland abstrafen
data.translatedDescription: The traces of the foiled drone attack at Leipzig Airport point to Moscow. What does the Chancellor do if the suspicion is confirmed? He could choose from these four options.

data.title: Alexander Dobrindt: Bundesinnenminister verteidigt Geheimdienstreform gegen Kritik
data.description: Bekämpfung von Sabotageakten und Hackerangriffen: Das Bundeskabinett will die Befugnisse der deutschen Nachrichtendienste ausweiten. Die Opposition kritisiert die Pläne, die Regierung schieße übers Ziel hinaus.
data.translatedTitle: Alexander Dobrindt: Bundesinnenminister verteidigt Geheimdienstreform gegen Kritik
data.translatedDescription: Combating acts of sabotage and hacker attacks: The Federal Cabinet wants to expand the powers of the German intelligence services. The opposition criticizes the plans, saying the government is overshooting its target.

data.title: Berlin: Politiker fordern wegen Spionageverdachts Schließung von Russischem Haus
data.description: Kultureinrichtung oder Spionagezentrale? Das Auswärtige Amt ist noch zurückhaltend, doch parteiübergreifend fordern Politiker ein härteres Vorgehen gegen das Russische Haus in Berlin. Deutschland strahle mit der Duldung »Schwäche pur« aus.
data.translatedTitle: Berlin: Politiker fordern wegen Spionageverdachts Schließung von Russischem Haus
data.translatedDescription: Cultural institution or spy center? The Foreign Office is still cautious, but politicians across party lines are calling for tougher action against the Russian House in Berlin. With its toleration, Germany exudes “pure weakness.”

data.title: SED-Opferbeauftragte will DDR-Geschichte im Unterricht verankern
data.description: Die DDR-Geschichte soll fest in den Lehrplan: Dafür plädiert Bundesbeauftragte Zupke kurz vor dem Mauerbau-Jahrestag. Dabei erinnert sie auch an die rund 37.000 Betroffenen, die noch heute eine Opferrente beziehen.
data.translatedTitle: SED-Opferbeauftragte will DDR-Geschichte im Unterricht verankern
data.translatedDescription: The history of the GDR should be firmly included in the curriculum: Federal Commissioner Zupke advocates this shortly before the anniversary of the building of the Wall. She also reminds us of the approximately 37,000 people affected who still receive a victim's pension today.

data.title: Online-Shopping: EU-Regelung bringt kleine Onlineshops in Existenznot
data.description: Die EU will den ausufernden Onlineversand nachhaltiger gestalten. Doch eine neue Regelung trifft auch kleine Shops – und bringt einige Selbstständige in Existenznot.
data.translatedTitle: Online-Shopping: EU-Regelung bringt kleine Onlineshops in Existenznot
data.translatedDescription: The EU wants to make the escalating online shipping more sustainable. But a new regulation also affects small shops - and puts some self-employed people in dire straits.

data.title: Technologieoffenheit: Warum kleinteiliges Handeln den Wandel voranbringt
data.description: Es braucht keinen Meisterplan, um die Welt zu verändern. Durch kleinteiliges Handeln kann ein neues Gesamtbild entstehen.
data.translatedTitle: Technologieoffenheit: Warum kleinteiliges Handeln den Wandel voranbringt
data.translatedDescription: You don't need a master plan to change the world. Through small-scale action, a new overall picture can emerge.

data.translatedTitle: Autofarben »Cement« und »Graphite«: Müssen Deutschlands Straßen echt noch grauer werden?

data.title: Spanien: Flüchtlingspolitik in der Kritik - Giorgia Meloni und Mette Frederiksen in Flüchtlingsfrage vereint

data.translatedTitle: Spanien: Flüchtlingspolitik in der Kritik - Giorgia Meloni und Mette Frederiksen in Flüchtlingsfrage vereint
data.translatedDescription: “We do not accept uncontrolled migration”: The right-wing populist Giorgia Meloni from Italy and the social democrat Mette Frederiksen from Denmark have published a joint manifesto. Now Sweden's Prime Minister is stepping up.

data.title: Erdbeben in Kolumbien: Rettungskräfte kämpfen gegen die Zeit
data.description: Mehr als 30 Stunden nach dem verheerenden Erdbeben in Kolumbien haben Retter eine 31-Jährige befreit: Noch können Menschen lebend gefunden werden, doch auch die Zahl der Toten steigt.
data.translatedTitle: Erdbeben in Kolumbien: Rettungskräfte kämpfen gegen die Zeit
data.translatedDescription: More than 30 hours after the devastating earthquake in Colombia, rescuers freed a 31-year-old woman: People can still be found alive, but the number of deaths is also rising.

data.title: BSW will bei Wahl in Sachsen-Anhalt Weg für AfD-Ministerpräsidenten freimachen
data.description: Gelingt dem BSW in Sachsen-Anhalt der Einzug ins Parlament, könnte es zur Königsmacherin werden. Die Partei plädiert dafür, die AfD in die Regierungsarbeit einzubeziehen. Gründerin Wagenknecht erklärt: »Die Brandmauer ist gescheitert.«
data.translatedTitle: BSW will bei Wahl in Sachsen-Anhalt Weg für AfD-Ministerpräsidenten freimachen
data.translatedDescription: If the BSW in Saxony-Anhalt succeeds in entering parliament, it could become a kingmaker. The party advocates including the AfD in government work. Founder Wagenknecht explains: “The firewall has failed.”

data.title: Libyen: Khalida Haftar verliert Militärgeheimdienstchef Fawsi al-Mansuridurch Anschlag
data.description: Erst war er beten, dann jagten Unbekannte sein Auto in die Luft: Fawsi al-Mansuri ist tot. Nach dem Sturz von Muammar al-Gaddafi kämpfte er gegen Dschihadisten und wurde so zu einem der mächtigsten Männer Libyens.
data.translatedTitle: Libyen: Khalida Haftar verliert Militärgeheimdienstchef Fawsi al-Mansuridurch Anschlag
data.translatedDescription: First he was praying, then unknown people blew up his car: Fawsi al-Mansuri is dead. After the fall of Muammar al-Gaddafi, he fought against jihadists and became one of the most powerful men in Libya.

data.title: Nordkorea feuert erneut ballistische Rakete ab – Anrainer warnen vor Risiken unangekündigter Tests
data.description: Im Juli testete China eine ballistische Rakete von einem U-Boot aus. Nun folgt Nordkorea mit einem Start vom Festland. Dutzende Staaten kritisieren die unangekündigten Tests und warnen vor folgenschweren Fehleinschätzungen.
data.translatedTitle: Nordkorea feuert erneut ballistische Rakete ab – Anrainer warnen vor Risiken unangekündigter Tests
data.translatedDescription: In July, China tested a ballistic missile from a submarine. Now North Korea is following suit with a start from the mainland. Dozens of countries criticize the unannounced tests and warn of serious misjudgments.

data.title: Wald-Brand bei Plauen in Sachsen: Feuerwehr muss zu Fuß anrücken
data.description: Seit Dienstagabend wütet bei Plauen ein Waldbrand, es ist der größte seit Jahrzehnten. Das Gelände ist allerdings mit Feuerwehrautos nicht befahrbar – und ein Ende der Löscharbeiten nicht in Sicht.
data.translatedTitle: Wald-Brand bei Plauen in Sachsen: Feuerwehr muss zu Fuß anrücken
data.translatedDescription: A forest fire has been raging near Plauen since Tuesday evening; it is the largest in decades. However, the area cannot be accessed by fire engines - and there is no end in sight to the extinguishing work.

data.title: Österreich: Wanderer aus Deutschland in Tiroler Bergen tödlich verunglückt
data.description: Ein 74-Jähriger aus Nordrhein-Westfalen war allein in den Tiroler Bergen unterwegs. Als er von seiner Wanderung nicht zurückkam, begann eine dramatische Suchaktion. Nun meldet die Polizei den Tod des Mannes.
data.translatedTitle: Austria: Hiker from Germany had a fatal accident in the Tyrolean mountains
data.translatedDescription: A 74-year-old from North Rhine-Westphalia was traveling alone in the Tyrolean mountains. When he didn't return from his hike, a dramatic search began. Now the police report the man's death.

data.title: Leichtathletik-EM 2026: Hammerwerfer Merlin Hummel - Zu Silber meditiert
data.description: Bei der Leichtathletik-EM in Birmingham läuft es miserabel für Hammerwerfer Merlin Hummel. Dann befreit er sich »fast hundertmal« von Hirngespinsten – und wird Zweiter. Sein nächstes Ziel ist klar.
data.translatedTitle: European Athletics Championships 2026: Hammer thrower Merlin Hummel - meditated on silver

data.translatedTitle: Mistérios dos primos: a espiral de Ulam

data.title: Watch: India’s Russian oil imports hit 48% as U.S. readies 100% tariffs
data.description: Russia’s share of India’s crude oil imports hit an all-time high of 48% in June 2026, even as the United States moves closer to imposing tariffs of up to 100% on countries buying Russian oil and gas. India imported 8.7 million metric tonnes of Russian crude in June, while overall crude imports fell sharply. The UAE also recorded a historic 17.5% share, meaning Russia and the UAE together accounted for nearly two-thirds of India’s oil imports.

data.title: DN Debatt. ”Tidöretorik och faktafel till framtidens svenskar”

data.translatedTitle: DN Debatt. ”Tidöretorik och faktafel till framtidens svenskar”
data.translatedDescription: DN DEBATE. This weekend, hopeful men and women sit down to write the citizenship test. But the educational material is characterized by factual errors and misinterpretations, especially when it comes to the climate. It is hard not to suspect that the Tidö parties had more than a hand in the game, writes Mattias Goldmann for the climate organization 2030 secretariat.

data.title: Europas omstridda territorier utanför Europa – där Trump ofta har ett finger med i spelet

data.title: Störtande satelliter kan hota ozonlagret
data.description: Allt fler satelliter skjuts upp i omloppsbana runt jorden, men så småningom ska de ner igen. Nu varnar forskare för att satelliterna kan bli så många att skrotet från dem påverkar vår atmosfär – och riskerar att skada ozonlagret.
data.translatedTitle: Störtande satelliter kan hota ozonlagret
data.translatedDescription: More and more satellites are launched into orbit around the Earth, but eventually they have to come down again. Now scientists are warning that the satellites may become so numerous that the scrap from them affects our atmosphere - and risks damaging the ozone layer.

data.title: Seismolog om skalvet i Colombia: ”Ovanligt stort”

data.translatedTitle: Seismolog om skalvet i Colombia: ”Ovanligt stort”

data.title: Kristofer Ahlström: Detta är det verkligt chockerande med Trumps offentliga sömn
data.description: På presskonferensen om minskad vaccinering verkar den amerikanska presidenten somna – igen. Det borde knappt vara överraskande längre, skriver DN:s Kristofer Ahlström. Förutom på en punkt. Att så många väljer att inte se.
data.translatedTitle: Kristofer Ahlström: Detta är det verkligt chockerande med Trumps offentliga sömn

data.title: Nieuwe EU-regels moeten vanaf woensdag tot minder verpakkingsafval leiden. Maar hoe kunnen kleine webwinkeliers dan nog pakjes over de grens sturen?
data.description: Minder verpakkingsafval en duurzamer materiaalgebruik, daar moeten nieuwe EU-regels voor verpakkingen vanaf woensdag  toe leiden. Betrokkenen klagen over onduidelijkheid en kleine online handelaars zeggen dat ze niet meer over de grens kunnen handelen wegens een registratieplicht in elk EU-land. „Ik zou voor één Zweedse klant 200 euro aan registratiekosten moeten betalen.”
data.translatedTitle: Nieuwe EU-regels moeten vanaf woensdag tot minder verpakkingsafval leiden. Maar hoe kunnen kleine webwinkeliers dan nog pakjes over de grens sturen?
data.translatedDescription: Less packaging waste and more sustainable use of materials are what new EU rules for packaging should lead to from Wednesday. Those involved complain about lack of clarity and small online traders say they can no longer trade across the border due to a registration requirement in every EU country. “I would have to pay 200 euros in registration fees for one Swedish customer.”

data.title: Droogtemonitor: ‘Het blijft droog, maatregelen om water vast te houden raken op’
data.description: De huidige situatie is „zeer bijzonder”; niet alleen stroomt er historisch weinig water door de Rijn en is de afvoer van water door de Maas laag, ook zijn de grondwaterstanden op de meeste plaatsen „laag tot extreem laag” en daalt het peil van het IJsselmeer. Dat zal de komende weken vermoedelijk zo blijven.
data.translatedTitle: Droogtemonitor: ‘Het blijft droog, maatregelen om water vast te houden raken op’
data.translatedDescription: The current situation is “very special”; Not only does historically little water flow through the Rhine and the discharge of water through the Meuse is low, the groundwater levels are also "low to extremely low" in most places and the level of the IJsselmeer is falling. This will probably remain the case in the coming weeks.

data.title: Vlak na Blanensku srazil dva lidi. Jeden střet nepřežil, nehodu vyšetřuje policie
data.description: Rychlík u železničního přejezdu v Rájci-Jestřebí na Blanensku srazil v úterý odpoledne dva muže pohybující se v kolejišti, jeden z nich střet nepřežil, druhý skončil v nemocnici se středně těžkým zraněním. Policie zjišťuje totožnost oběti, okolnosti neštěstí vyšetřuje, řekli mluvčí policie Petra Hrůzová a záchranářů Lukáš Dvořáček. Doprava na trati byla asi 2,5 hodiny přerušená.
data.translatedTitle: Vlak na Blanensku srazil dva lidi. Jeden střet nepřežil, nehodu vyšetřuje policie
data.translatedDescription: On Tuesday afternoon, a high-speed train hit two men moving in the rail yard near the railway crossing in Rájc-Jestřebí in Blanensko. One of them did not survive the collision, the other ended up in hospital with moderate injuries. The police are establishing the identity of the victim and investigating the circumstances of the accident, said police spokeswoman Petra Hrůzová and paramedics Lukáš Dvořáček. Traffic on the track was interrupted for about 2.5 hours.

data.title: Středomoří se mění kvůli oteplování. Invazivní druhy získávají převahu
data.description: Pepis, vousatý kapitán malé rybářské lodi, obratně vytahuje dva perutýny ulovené v pokusných pastech u pobřeží Kypru, odřezává jim jedovaté ostny, vyvrhuje je a hází do kbelíku. Středozemní moře okolo něj vypadá, jako by bylo ze skla, a jeho klidný povrch nijak nenaznačuje dramatickou proměnu, která se odehrává pod hladinou.
data.translatedTitle: Středomoří se mění kvůli oteplování. Invazivní druhy získávají převahu
data.translatedDescription: Pepis, the bearded captain of a small fishing boat, deftly retrieves two lionfish caught in experimental traps off the coast of Cyprus, cuts off their poisonous spines, disgorges them and throws them into a bucket. The Mediterranean Sea around it looks as if it were made of glass, and its calm surface gives no hint of the dramatic transformation that is taking place below the surface.

data.title: Severní Korea vystřelila další balistickou raketu do Japonského moře
data.description: Severní Korea v úterý ze svého východního pobřeží vystřelila směrem k Japonskému moři balistickou raketu, která zřejmě dopadla mimo výlučnou ekonomickou zónu Japonska. Stalo se tak necelý týden poté, co KLDR stejným směrem odpálila jinou balistickou raketu, a několik dní před společným americko-jihokorejským vojenským cvičením.
data.translatedTitle: Severní Korea vystřelila další balistickou raketu do Japonského moře
data.translatedDescription: North Korea fired a ballistic missile from its east coast toward the Sea of ​​Japan on Tuesday, apparently landing outside Japan's exclusive economic zone. This came less than a week after the DPRK launched another ballistic missile in the same direction, and a few days before a joint US-South Korean military exercise.

data.title: USA obvinily členy mexického kartelu z pokusu koupit zbraně v Česku
data.description: Americké úřady obvinily čtyři členy mexického kartelu CJNG z pokusu nakoupit zbraně a střelivo v Česku, za což jim hrozí doživotí; dva z nich už byli vydáni do USA a o vydání dalších dvou se jedná.
data.translatedTitle: USA obvinily členy mexického kartelu z pokusu koupit zbraně v Česku
data.translatedDescription: American authorities accused four members of the Mexican CJNG cartel of trying to buy weapons and ammunition in the Czech Republic, for which they face life in prison; two of them have already been released to the US and another two are in the process of being released.

data.title: Americká výsledková sezona: divoká jízda BigTechu, farmaceutů i ropných gigantů
data.description: Od bilionových výprodejů k historickým rekordům. Stačily dva týdny, aby se nálada na globálních trzích otočila o 180 stupňů. Ještě v polovině července na Wall Streetu panoval strach, že mánie kolem umělé inteligence je jen praskající bublina. Začátkem srpna technologické firmy v čele s Amazonem, Applem, Microsoftem či Palantirem investorům ukázaly, že generují obrovské zisky. A nejen ony – 86 procent společností z indexu S&P 500 překonalo očekávání analytiků.
data.translatedTitle: Americká výsledková sezona: divoká jízda BigTechu, farmaceutů i ropných gigantů
data.translatedDescription: From trillion-dollar sales to all-time records. It only took two weeks for the mood in global markets to turn 180 degrees. As recently as mid-July, Wall Street feared that the artificial intelligence mania was just a bursting bubble. At the beginning of August, technology companies led by Amazon, Apple, Microsoft and Palantir showed investors that they generate huge profits. And not just them - 86 percent of S&P 500 companies beat analysts' expectations.

data.title: Vondráček na Hrad? Zemanův nápad se v koalici líbí, nepohrdal by prý Ústavou
data.description: Rada bývalého prezidenta Miloše Zemana, který vládní koalici doporučil jako společného kandidáta proti Petru Pavlovi místopředsedu ANO Radka Vondráčka, rozvířila v posledních dnech velkou diskusi. Redakce iDNES.cz se proto zajímala, co vládní politici na Zemanův nápad vlastně říkají. Minimálně části z nich se jméno Radka Vondráčka zamlouvá.
data.translatedTitle: Vondráček na Hrad? Zemanův nápad se v koalici líbí, nepohrdal by prý Ústavou
data.translatedDescription: The council of former President Miloš Zeman, who recommended ANO vice-chairman Radek Vondráček to the government coalition as a joint candidate against Petr Pavlov, stirred up a great debate in recent days. The editors of iDNES.cz were therefore interested in what government politicians actually say about Zeman's idea. At least some of them like the name Radko Vondráček.

data.title: Nejbohatší Rusku drtí ukrajinské drony. Wildberries bez pomoci Kremlu nepřežije
data.description: Z učitelky angličtiny na mateřské dovolené se vypracovala na nejbohatští ženu Ruska – za dvacet let ovládla domácí trh a postavila impérium, kterému se přezdívá ruský Amazon. Teď čelí Taťjana Kimová a její firma Wildberries zřejmě vůbec největší krizi, válce a ukrajinským dronům. A v Kremlu řeší, co s tím.
data.translatedTitle: Nejbohatší Rusku drtí ukrajinské drony. Wildberries bez pomoci Kremlu nepřežije
data.translatedDescription: She rose from an English teacher on maternity leave to become the richest woman in Russia - in twenty years she dominated the domestic market and built an empire that is nicknamed the Russian Amazon. Now Taťjana Kimová and her company Wildberries are facing probably the biggest crisis ever, war and Ukrainian drones. And in the Kremlin, they decide what to do with it.

data.title: Popel ze soptící Etny pokryl Katánii. Prach přerušil na místním letišti provoz
data.description: Etna na Sicílii za poslední dny znovu předvádí svou sílu. Silné výbuchy chrlí do okolí popel a sopečný prach, který v Katánii pokryl auta, ulice i další veřejná prostranství. Oblaky popela výrazně zkomplikovaly také leteckou dopravu. Místní letiště muselo kvůli bezpečnosti přerušit všechny přílety i odlety.
data.translatedTitle: Popel ze soptící Etny pokryl Katánii. Prach přerušil na místním letišti provoz
data.translatedDescription: Etna in Sicily has been showing its power again in recent days. Strong explosions spew ash and volcanic dust into the surroundings, which covered cars, streets and other public spaces in Catania. The ash clouds also significantly complicated air transport. The local airport had to suspend all arrivals and departures for safety reasons.

data.title: Za vykopnutými dveřmi čekal ten „pravý“. Omyl petrohradské policie skončil svatbou
data.description: Případ chybného policejního zásahu v ruském Petrohradu měl neobvyklou dohru. Vyšetřovatelka z tamních bezpečnostních složek se při razii vtrhnutím do nesprávného bytu, kterému policie vyrazila dveře, seznámila s jeho majitelem. Zákrok, který měl původně vést k zatčení nebezpečného uprchlíka, tak o dva roky později vyústil ve svatbu.
data.translatedTitle: Za vykopnutými dveřmi čekal ten „pravý“. Omyl petrohradské policie skončil svatbou
data.translatedDescription: The case of an erroneous police intervention in St. Petersburg, Russia, had an unusual outcome. An investigator from the local security forces got to know its owner during a raid by breaking into the wrong apartment, whose door the police broke down. The intervention, which was originally supposed to lead to the arrest of a dangerous fugitive, resulted in a wedding two years later.

data.title: Kolumbie je po zemětřesení v nouzovém stavu. Mrtvých přibývá po desítkách
data.description: Pondělní zemětřesení v Kolumbii podle posledních údajů samosprávných celků zabilo nejméně 240 lidí. Kolumbijský prezident Abelardo de la Espriella ale informoval o 181 mrtvých. Zraněných je přes tisíc. Nejvíce mrtvých hlásí město Cali, což je třetí nejlidnatější kolumbijské město. Zemětřesení o síle 7,4 stupně zasáhlo takzvaný kávový region.
data.translatedTitle: Kolumbie je po zemětřesení v nouzovém stavu. Mrtvých přibývá po desítkách
data.translatedDescription: Monday's earthquake in Colombia killed at least 240 people, according to the latest data from local governments. But Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella reported 181 dead. Over a thousand are injured. Cali, Colombia's third most populous city, reports the most deaths. A 7.4-magnitude earthquake hit the so-called coffee region.

data.title: Roky v ruském vězení dohnaly Američana prakticky k šílenství. Putin ho pustil domů
data.description: Rusko v úterý propustilo Američana Roberta Gilmana, který v tamním vězení strávil více než čtyři roky poté, co byl obviněn z napadení policisty. Ruský prezident Vladimir Putin mu s ohledem na špatný zdravotní stav udělil milost z humanitárních důvodů, uvedli američtí činitelé.
data.translatedTitle: Roky v ruském vězení dohnaly Američana prakticky k šílenství. Putin ho pustil domů
data.translatedDescription: Russia on Tuesday released American Robert Gilman, who spent more than four years in prison there after he was accused of assaulting a police officer. Russian President Vladimir Putin granted him a humanitarian pardon due to his poor health, US officials said.

data.title: Špióni byli v íránském jaderném zařízení jako doma, naznačil bývalý šéf Mossadu
data.description: Špioni izraelské tajné služby Mossad byli v íránském jaderném zařízení ve Fordo prakticky jako doma. V minulosti ho mnohokrát navštívili, aby mu lépe porozuměli, uvedl bývalý šéf služby Josi Cohen na konferenci ve městě Safe,.
data.translatedTitle: Špióni byli v íránském jaderném zařízení jako doma, naznačil bývalý šéf Mossadu
data.translatedDescription: Israel's Mossad spies were practically at home at the Iranian nuclear facility in Fordo. They visited him many times in the past to better understand him, said former head of the service Josi Cohen at a conference in the city of Safe,.

data.title: „Muslimské NATO“ je pro nás hrozba, zní z Izraele. Írán mluví o sjednocení
data.description: Turecko, Pákistán a Saúdská Arábie uzavřením vzájemné obranné dohody položily ve stínu íránské hrozby základy takzvaného „islámského NATO“. Z Íránu zaznívají hlasy, že pro něj spojenectví nepředstavuje hrozbu, i výzvy k bratrské spolupráci. V Izraeli naopak panují obavy, že pakt bude namířen proti němu – a to vzhledem k protiizraelským výhrůžkám ze strany Turecka i Pákistánu.
data.translatedTitle: „Muslimské NATO“ je pro nás hrozba, zní z Izraele. Írán mluví o sjednocení
data.translatedDescription: Turkey, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia, by concluding a mutual defense agreement, laid the foundations of the so-called "Islamic NATO" in the shadow of the Iranian threat. There are voices from Iran that the alliance does not pose a threat to it, as well as calls for brotherly cooperation. In Israel, on the other hand, there are fears that the pact will be turned against it – given the anti-Israel threats from both Turkey and Pakistan.

data.title: Konec strašidelného domu. Architektka Jiřičná zahájila proměnu mrakodrapu v Ostravě
data.description: Šťastnější éru má podle architektů, developera i vedení města před sebou někdejší nejvyšší obytná budova v České republice. Slavnostním poklepáním na základní kámen začala přestavba mrakodrapu stojícího od roku 1968 naproti ostravské Nové radnici. Autorkou proměny se stala známá architektka Eva Jiřičná.
data.translatedTitle: Konec strašidelného domu. Architektka Jiřičná zahájila proměnu mrakodrapu v Ostravě
data.translatedDescription: According to the architects, the developer and the city management, the former tallest residential building in the Czech Republic has a happier era ahead of it. The reconstruction of the skyscraper, which has been standing since 1968 across from Ostrava's New Town Hall, began with a ceremonial tapping of the foundation stone. The author of the transformation was the well-known architect Eva Jiřičná.

data.title: OBRAZEM: Čína má po tajfunu vody na rozdávání. Za den napršelo jak za 4 měsíce
data.description: Tajfun Dolphin drtí Čínu. Od Pekingu až po vnitrozemskou provincii Chu-pej sužuje zemi extrémní průtrž mračen, která zatápí ulice, zastavuje dálniční stavby a žene nádrže v okolí přes havarijní limity. Tisíce lidí musely opustit své domovy a i metropoli hrozí, že během jediného dne dosáhne přídělu srážek za celé měsíce.
data.translatedTitle: OBRAZEM: Čína má po tajfunu vody na rozdávání. Za den napršelo jak za 4 měsíce
data.translatedDescription: Typhoon Dolphin crushes China. From Beijing to the inland province of Hubei, the country is being battered by an extreme cloudburst that is flooding streets, halting highway construction and pushing nearby reservoirs past emergency limits. Thousands of people had to leave their homes, and even the metropolis is in danger of reaching months' worth of rainfall in a single day.

data.title: Český film Neporazitelní chystá anglickou verzi. Připravuje se uvedení v USA
data.description: Tým českého filmu Neporazitelní dokončuje anglický dabing a s americkým distributorem Highland Film Group připravuje uvedení v USA a na dalších zahraničních trzích. Producent filmu Petr Jákl do projektu přinesl své dlouholeté vazby na americký filmový průmysl.
data.translatedTitle: Český film Neporazitelní chystá anglickou verzi. Připravuje se uvedení v USA
data.translatedDescription: The team of the Czech film Neporazitelní is completing the English dubbing and is preparing a release in the USA and other foreign markets with the American distributor Highland Film Group. The film's producer Petr Jákl brought his long-standing ties to the American film industry to the project.

data.title: Měchy mi šlapala i manželka, jiný z toho vysílením málem omdlel. Varhaník vypráví
data.description: Česko je varhanní velmocí, v kostelích jsou jich tisíce. Aby varhany fungovaly, musí se na ně hrát. „Je to jako s autem: když nejezdíte, stav se začne zhoršovat,“ říká varhaník Adam Viktora pro magazín Víkend DNES.
data.translatedTitle: Měchy mi šlapala i manželka, jiný z toho vysílením málem omdlel. Varhaník vypráví
data.translatedDescription: The Czech Republic is an organ superpower, there are thousands of them in churches. In order for the organ to work, it must be played. "It's like a car: if you don't drive, the condition starts to deteriorate," says organist Adam Viktora for Víkend DNES magazine.

data.title: Soud rehabilitoval číhošťského farníka, odmítl svědčit proti faráři Toufarovi
data.description: Krajský soud v Hradci Králové v úterý rehabilitoval číhošťského farníka a očitého svědka takzvaného číhošťského zázraku z prosince 1949 Václava Trtíka. Tento muž, který byl v roce 1950 vězněn v souvislosti s perzekucí faráře Josefa Toufara umučeného komunistickou Státní bezpečností (StB), byl tehdy ve věci nezákonně zadržován, vyplynulo z dnešního rozhodnutí soudu.
data.translatedTitle: Soud rehabilitoval číhošťského farníka, odmítl svědčit proti faráři Toufarovi
data.translatedDescription: On Tuesday, the regional court in Hradec Králové rehabilitated Václav Trtík, a parishioner from Čihošť and an eyewitness to the so-called Čihošť miracle from December 1949. This man, who was imprisoned in 1950 in connection with the persecution of priest Josef Toufar, who was martyred by the communist State Security (StB), was then illegally detained in the case, according to today's court decision.

data.title: Výluka mezi Radotínem a Smíchovem startuje dřív, vybrané vlaky nevyjedou
data.description: Kvůli přestavbě smíchovského nádraží musí Správa železnic přistoupit k dřívější výluce koleje směrem na Radotín. Což od středy omezí osobní vlaky. Část z nich pojede odklonem přes Branický most mimo Smíchov a Chuchli.
data.translatedTitle: Výluka mezi Radotínem a Smíchovem startuje dřív, vybrané vlaky nevyjedou
data.translatedDescription: Due to the reconstruction of the Smíchov railway station, the Railway Administration has to proceed with the earlier exclusion of the track towards Radotín. Which will limit passenger trains from Wednesday. Part of them will take a detour across the Branický most outside of Smíchov and Chuchli.

data.title: Novým maďarským prezidentem se stal András Baka. Opozice hlasování bojkotovala
data.description: Maďarský parlament v úterý zvolil bývalého předsedu nejvyššího soudu Andráse Baku novým prezidentem, uvedly tiskové agentury. Opozice volby bojkotovala, Baka byl jediný kandidát a zvolen byl hlasy vládní strany Tisza, která má v parlamentu více než dvoutřetinovou většinu.
data.translatedTitle: Novým maďarským prezidentem se stal András Baka. Opozice hlasování bojkotovala
data.translatedDescription: Hungary's parliament elected former Supreme Court chief András Baku as its new president on Tuesday, news agencies reported. The opposition boycotted the election, Baka was the only candidate and was elected by the votes of the ruling Tisza party, which has more than a two-thirds majority in parliament.

data.title: Streetartista chodníkovými mozaikami vyzdobil Brno. O svolení radši nežádám, říká
data.description: Když se objeví díra v chodníku, většina lidí ji obejde. Matěj Krajíček si nad ni sedne a začne ji vyplňovat střepy, dlaždičkami a sklíčky. V mnoha městech po něm zůstávají mozaiky, které baví kolemjdoucí i sociální sítě. V Brně jich zanechal sedm a chystá se na zvelebení koše před nádražím.
data.translatedTitle: A street artist decorated Brno with pavement mosaics. I prefer not to ask for permission, he says
data.translatedDescription: When there is a hole in the sidewalk, most people walk around it. Matěj Krajíček sits on top of it and starts filling it with shards, tiles and glasses. In many cities, mosaics remain after him, which amuse passers-by and social networks. He left seven of them in Brno and is preparing to improve the bin in front of the station.

data.title: Nahradit Hormuz není snadné. Transport ropy možnosti nabízí, s plynem je to horší
data.description: Válka s Íránem ukázala, jak silně je světový obchod se strategickými surovinami závislý na Hormuzském průlivu. Před vypuknutím konfliktu tudy proudila zhruba pětina světových dodávek ropy i LNG. Útoky z posledních měsíců přiměly státy Perského zálivu urychlit hledání alternativních tras. Rozšiřují ropovody, přístavy a hledají i další možnosti přepravy.
data.translatedTitle: Replacing Hormuz is not easy. The transport of oil offers possibilities, with gas it is worse
data.translatedDescription: The war with Iran showed how strongly the world trade in strategic raw materials depends on the Strait of Hormuz. Before the outbreak of the conflict, roughly a fifth of the world's oil and LNG supplies flowed through this route. The attacks in recent months have prompted the Gulf states to accelerate the search for alternative routes. They are expanding oil pipelines, ports and looking for other transportation options.

data.title: Insolvenční správce zpronevěřil 67 milionů. Berte ohled na můj věk, obměkčoval soud
data.description: Bývalého insolvenčního správce Václava Svobodu poslal českobudějovický krajský soud do vězení na pět let a šest měsíců za zpronevěru. Podle obžaloby vyváděl z úschovy splátky zadlužených firem na své účty a používal je pro vlastní potřebu. O kauze jako první informoval web Seznam Zprávy.
data.translatedTitle: The insolvency administrator embezzled 67 million. Consider my age, softened the judgment
data.translatedDescription: Former insolvency administrator Václav Svoboda was sent to prison for five years and six months by the České Budějovice Regional Court for embezzlement. According to the indictment, he diverted installments of indebted companies from escrow to his accounts and used them for his own use. The Seznam Zprávy website was the first to report on the case.

data.title: Skandál kolem nového sdružení. Pod jeho volební peticí jsou zfalšované podpisy
data.description: Zneužití osobních údajů a zfalšované podpisy doprovázejí podle zjištění iDNES.cz volební petici pro nové nezávislé sdružení Náš Dvůr, které podalo kandidátku do komunálních voleb ve Dvoře Králové nad Labem na Trutnovsku. Dokument obsahuje jména lidí, kteří subjekt nikdy nepodpořili a petici nepodepsali. Městský úřad nechá záležitost prošetřit, obrátí se na státní zastupitelství.
data.translatedTitle: The scandal surrounding the new association. There are forged signatures under his election petition
data.translatedDescription: According to the findings of iDNES.cz, misuse of personal data and forged signatures accompany the election petition for the new independent association Náš Dvůr, which submitted a candidate for the municipal elections in Dvůr Králové nad Labem in Trutnovsk. The document contains the names of people who never supported the entity and did not sign the petition. The city office will have the matter investigated, it will turn to the public prosecutor's office.

data.title: Ministři pospolu, zdolání švýcarských hor i cyklistika. Jak politici trávili dovolenou
data.description: Polovina letního volna je pryč a politikům se pomalu blíží konec sněmovních prázdnin. Někteří trávili dovolenou se svými kolegy u moře, jiní zdolávali vrcholky švýcarských hor a další objevovali krásy jižní Moravy.
data.translatedTitle: Ministers together, conquering the Swiss mountains and cycling. How politicians spent their holidays
data.translatedDescription: Half of the summer vacation is over and the end of the parliamentary vacation is slowly approaching for politicians. Some spent their holidays with their colleagues by the sea, others climbed the peaks of the Swiss mountains and others discovered the beauty of South Moravia.

data.title: Konflikt mezi mužem a ženou zburcoval policii, k bytu dorazila taky zásahovka
data.description: Záběry skoro jako z akčního filmu se dnes naskytly obyvatelům Chocně na Orlickoústecku. Policisté v úterý ráno uzavřeli v blízkosti centra Chocně jednu z ulic, kde v jednom z bytů došlo ke konfliktu mezi mužem a ženou. Jelikož policisté měli podezření, že je padesátiletý cizinec ozbrojený, na místo vyslali také zásahovou jednotku.
data.translatedTitle: The conflict between a man and a woman incited the police, and an emergency team also arrived at the apartment
data.translatedDescription: Footage almost like from an action movie appeared today to the residents of Chocna in Orlickousteck. Otřesy podle kolumbijské asociace hlavních měst regionů Asocapitales zničily 61 budov a poškodily 1575 domů. Počet obětí pravděpodobně ještě poroste, pokračuje totiž pátrání po nezvěstných, kterých je například jen ve městě Cali podle prezidenta jihoamerické země Abelarda de la Esprielly 188.
data.translatedTitle: A devastating earthquake in Colombia has killed at least 169 people. Hundreds more are missing
data.translatedDescription: At least 169 people died in Monday's earthquake in Colombia, wrote the server of the Colombian newspaper El Tiempo. The number of injured rose to more than 900. The tremors destroyed 61 buildings and damaged 1,575 houses, according to the Colombian association of regional capitals Asocapitales. The number of victims is likely to increase, as the search for the missing continues, of which, for example, there are 188 in the city of Cali alone, according to the president of the South American country, Abelardo de la Espriella.

data.title: Zelensky congratulates Saudi Arabia’s crown prince on Makkah defense agreement
data.description:
RIYADH: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky congratulated Saudi Arabia’s Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman on Monday for the recent signing of a regional defense agreement.

	Zelensky said he hopes the Makkah Joint Defense Agreement signed between Saudi Arabia, Turkiye and Pakistan last week will contribute to achieving security and stability in the region.

	He made the comments during a phone call with the crown prince, Saudi Press Agency reported.

	The two leaders also discussed regional and international developments.

data.title: Sports Boulevard launches $186m fund to develop Urban Wadi assets
data.description:
JEDDAH: The Sports Boulevard Real Estate Development and Investment Co. has signed agreements with Rikaz Properties to establish its third real estate investment fund, valued at more than $186 million, to develop key assets including a luxury five-star hotel in Riyadh’s Urban Wadi.

	The fund will finance the development of the hotel in the Hittin district, with Rikaz Properties serving as developer and investor and Al Jazira Capital acting as fund manager, according to an official statement.

data.title: Ukraine’s Zelensky says up to 50,000 North Korean troops to be deployed in Russia

data.title: Iran supreme leader names Guards general Abdollahi military chief
data.description:
TEHRAN: Iranian supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei named Revolutionary Guards general Ali Abdollahi head of the country's armed forces on Monday, while also confirming a new commander of the Guards, putting his imprimatur on the country's military.

data.title: Houthis launch new drone wave across Yemen’s government-held areas
data.description:
AL-MUKALLA: At least two Yemeni government soldiers were killed in southern Yemen as the Houthis launched a new wave of drone attacks on government-controlled areas in Aden, Mocha and Shabwa.

	The escalation came as the Yemeni army vowed on Monday to respond to Houthi drone and missile strikes on the Red Sea port city of Mocha that killed seven people and wounded 30 others.
